# About Culture Things

> About Culture Things offers shared guided tours from Lisbon to Sintra, the Atlantic coast, Fátima and Óbidos in a luxury Mercedes-Benz Vito. Prices are per person and each traveller has an assigned seat.

## Identity

- Brand: About Culture Things
- Service: Shared small-group guided tours and day trips from Lisbon
- Location: Sintra and Lisbon, Portugal
- Team: Local guides; the assigned guide is confirmed with each booking
- Languages listed by the business: English, Spanish and Portuguese
- Contact: aboutculturethings@gmail.com · +351 968 510 019
- Reviews: https://www.tripadvisor.com/Attraction_Review-g189158-d28016472-Reviews-About_Culture_Things-Lisbon_Lisbon_District_Central_Portugal.html

About Culture Things communicates as a service team. The assigned local guide and booking details are confirmed directly with the customer; no team size is stated.

## Current shared experiences

### Sintra Complete & Atlantic Coast

- URL: https://aboutculturethings.com/experiences/sintra-atlantic-coast/
- Price: €179 per person
- Duration: 7 hours
- Format: Shared luxury van; assigned seat per traveller
- Route: Historic Sintra, Serra de Sintra viewpoints, Pena Palace viewpoint, Cabo da Roca and Cascais
- Palace tickets and meals are not included

### Sintra & Hidden Beaches

- URL: https://aboutculturethings.com/experiences/sintra-hidden-beaches/
- Price: €139 per person
- Duration: 5 hours
- Format: Shared luxury van; assigned seat per traveller
- Route: Historic Sintra, mountain viewpoints, Praia das Maçãs, Azenhas do Mar and Praia da Aguda
- Palace tickets and meals are not included

### Fátima & Óbidos

- URL: https://aboutculturethings.com/experiences/fatima-obidos/
- Price: €259 per person
- Duration: Full day
- Format: Shared luxury van; assigned seat per traveller
- Route: Lisbon pickup, Óbidos, Fátima Sanctuary and Lisbon drop-off
- Meals are not included

## Booking facts

- Lisbon hotel or accommodation pickup is included
- A local guide, dedicated driver and shared Mercedes-Benz Vito transport are included
- Shared departures are confirmed from 4 travellers
- The nine-seat Vito is a luxury van, not a coach; operational guest capacity depends on crew and legally available seating
- Larger parties may be coordinated with additional vehicles, subject to availability
- The shared itinerary is planned; timing may adjust for traffic, weather and conditions
- Free cancellation with 24 hours’ notice is stated on the website
- Availability, payment and exact pickup details are confirmed by reply
